question: In which bodily locations should the practitioner meditate on this moon?
premises: The practitioner should meditate on this moon.
The locations include the navel and head.
The location also includes the heart.
inference: The practitioner should meditate on this moon in the navel, head, and heart.
plain_english: O goddess, one should meditate on this moon as located in the navel, the head, and the heart.
